Hi Annelise / Hiroshi —

Thanks again for moving this forward. We want a single technical deep-dive where our Solutions Engineer (Karthik) can run through the integration path and live KV cache walk-throughs with your architects. Because this will involve hands-on Q&A, we need a window that actually gives at least 90 minutes of overlap for SE + customer architects across US / EU / APAC.

Quick context and constraints:
- Target dates: Oct 26–28 (we're trying to lock something that sits right around the EU DST transition).
- EU DST ends Sun Oct 25 in 2026; the US change is Nov 1 — that creates a one-week shifting edge where nominal UTC offsets are tricky.
- We can do two shorter sessions (AM/EM local) as a fallback if a single 90m corridor isn't possible.

Attached is a quick CSV with candidate three-hour bands we scraped from everyone's stated availability and a timezone matrix image that highlights DST shifts. Can you confirm which of the proposed bands (sheet: proposed_windows.csv) would let at least two of your architects join live? If not, please suggest 2–3 specific local times and we'll try to map.

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) You mark preferred bands in the CSV (or reply with local times).
2) We'll propose concrete calendar invites (we can record one session and make the other small follow-up for hands-on).

Thanks — appreciate you juggling the timezone gymnastics.

—

Hi Lauren —

Thanks for sending. I gave the CSV a first pass and highlighted three bands that look viable for Novalabs architects:
- Option A: Oct 26, 13:00–16:00 CET (we can commit two architects for the 13:30–15:00 portion)
- Option B: Oct 27, 08:00–11:00 CET (better for our APAC liaison to hop on early)
- Option C: Oct 28, 16:00–19:00 CET (late EU, better overlap with west coast)

Notes:
- We do need to be explicit about the DST transition: Oct 26 is still CEST (UTC+2) in their local calendars until early Sunday; Oct 27 on some calendars might already show CET depending on local clients. I flagged the row where that flip happens in the CSV.
- Our preference: two-session approach (Option A for a thorough live run; Option C recorded + smaller hands-on for APAC).

Hiroshi (cc'd) — can you confirm APAC availability for Option A vs. Option C? Both are workable but one favors JST attendees.

Regards,

Thanks — great notes, Annelise. Quick feasibility call from SE side:

- We can cover a full 90m hands-on at the following UTC anchors without sacrificing demo quality:
  * UTC 11:30–13:00 (which is 07:30–09:00 PT / 12:30–14:00 CET / 20:30–22:00 JST)
  * UTC 16:00–17:30 (12:00–13:30 PT / 17:00–18:30 CET / 01:00–02:30 JST next day) — note the JST slot is late night.

Operational preference: run Option A (Oct 26 midday CET / morning PT) for the live deep-dive so we get maximum EU + US engineer overlap, then follow with a 45–60m APAC-focused hands-on within 24–48h (recording + short live Q&A). This avoids putting anyone in the 01:00 JST range for a long session.

If Novalabs confirms 13:30–15:00 CET on Oct 26, I'll block Karthik's calendar and prepare a 20-min pre-reads doc + a short runbook for the KV cache demo. I've attached a small ics stub we'll use as the invite template.
